Toddler meals

Tomato vegetable soup

Zöldséges paradicsomkrémleves

6 months+ Sound idea 30 min 4 portions

Serve warm in a bowl. It is a complete soft meal without cream.

Freezes well.

Ingredients

  • 3 medium Tomatoes (Chopped)
  • 1 medium Carrot (Peeled and chopped)
  • 1 medium Potato (Peeled and chopped)
  • 1 small Red pepper (Seeds removed and chopped)
  • 400 ml Water (Enough to simmer the vegetables)
  • 1 tablespoon Olive oil (Stirred in after blending)

Allergens

none

Method

  1. Put the tomatoes, carrot, potato, red pepper, and water in a pan.
  2. Simmer until the potato and carrot are very soft.
  3. Blend until completely smooth.
  4. Stir in the olive oil off the heat.
  5. Cool to serving temperature.

Sound idea

Salt and cream are not required. The vegetables should be blended smooth for the early months.

Cook tomato, carrot, potato, and red pepper, blend them, and stir olive oil in at the end.
